claims.text: The survey reports 34% of respondents at operating margins 16%+, alongside one-third nondisclosure. It provides an observed profitability signal for the sample, not EBITDA or a marketwide distribution.
The 34% reporting revenue $5M+ cannot be assumed to be the same 34% reporting margin 16%+. No joint distribution or independent ownership information is provided.
AMB publicly advertises 7–10x EBITDA for quality operators. This establishes its stated practitioner view only; no inspectable comps or sample support is supplied.
The advertised range overlaps both sides of a 9x ceiling, so it supports plausibility at some prices but does not support assuming all quality operators are available within the ceiling.

Arithmetic scenario only: at assumed 8x EV/EBITDA, EV $10–50M corresponds to EBITDA $1.25–6.25M. If additionally assuming 20% EBITDA margin, revenue would be $6.25–31.25M. Neither assumption is a measured typical HOA multiple/margin, and FCAR operating margin is not silently treated as EBITDA. This scenario demonstrates numeric compatibility, not population size or eligibility.

Advertised bank-deposit revenue streams warrant distinguishing provider fees/incentives from principal banking, custody or credit exposure. They do not establish any particular risk allocation or violation of the strategy.

gaps.question: What joint revenue, adjusted-EBITDA and independent ownership population exists in the exact HOA market, including low-profit and undisclosed observations?
What auditable aggregate completed HOA-management transactions establish EV $10–50M availability at or below 9x EBITDA, with comparable adjustments and dates?
How do ancillary deposit-linked fees affect provider economics and contractual financial exposure without conflating client assets with provider assets?

search_stop: Two sources admitted. No auditable public aggregate transaction dataset found in bounded lookup. Generic property-management paid report, secondary news and unsupported broker ranges not treated as measured HOA comps. No direct lease aggregate found; no further search authorized in this bounded task.
